newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dae Young, two others limit-down on probe report.
newsitem.headline: Dae Young, two others limit-down on probe report.

text.p: Shares of Dae Young Packaging Co and two other companies fell limit-down in late Thursday trading on a news report that the prosecution was probing suspicion of price manipulation of the stock, brokers said.
The two others are Daesung Electric Wire Co and Jungil Industrial Co. The prosecution denied the report.
Dae Young was down 4,300 won to 50,100, Daesung down 5,800 won to 67,200 and Jungil down 5,300 won to 61,700.

The local daily Kookmin Ilbo said there was suspicion that manipulation was responsible for an increase of up to 350 percent in the share prices of the three companies. The newspaper gave no source for its report.
It said the pmanipulation probe was in connection with an investigation into President Kim Young-sam's second son, Kim Hyun-chul, over a loans scandal involving Hanbo Steel Co.
